front.title: Computational Identity Fragmentation (CIF) Measurement and Reporting for Agentic Systems

abstract.t: This document defines a measurement protocol and reporting format for Computational Identity Fragmentation (CIF) in multi-model and multi-agent systems. CIF quantifies discontinuities in state, memory, policy, authority, and lineage across runtimes that share an underlying model family. The protocol enables independent observers to compute a CIF score and emit structured evidence records. Motivating incidents from 2025-2026, including the July 2026 ExploitGym evaluations in which hundreds of agents coordinated across discontinuous contexts, demonstrate the need for measurable identity continuity.
